sourceQuotes.zh: 清順治十八年，海寇鄭成功逐荷蘭人據之，偽置承天府，名曰東都，設二縣，曰天興，曰萬年。
sourceQuotes.literal: In the eighteenth year of Shunzhi of Qing, the sea bandit Zheng Chenggong drove out the Dutch and seized it; he falsely set up Chengtian Prefecture, called it the Eastern Capital, and established two counties named Tianxing and Wannian.
sourceQuotes.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Shunzhi (1661), the pirate Zheng Chenggong expelled the Dutch and held the island; he set up a rebel Chengtian Prefecture, styled it the Eastern Capital, and created two counties, Tianxing and Wannian.

sourceQuotes.zh: 其子鄭經改東都為東寧省，升二縣為州。
sourceQuotes.literal: His son Zheng Jing changed the Eastern Capital to Dongning Province and promoted the two counties to prefectures.
sourceQuotes.idiomatic: His son Zheng Jing renamed the Eastern Capital Dongning Province and elevated the two counties to departments.

sourceQuotes.zh: 康熙二十二年討平之，改置臺灣府，屬福建省，領縣三。
sourceQuotes.literal: In the twenty-second year of Kangxi it was pacified; Taiwan Prefecture was established, subordinate to Fujian Province, administering three counties.
sourceQuotes.idiomatic: In Kangxi 22 the island was pacified; Taiwan Prefecture was established under Fujian Province, with three counties under its jurisdiction.

sourceQuotes.zh: 光緒十三年九月庚午，閩浙總督楊昌濬、臺灣巡撫劉銘傳會奏，略云：「臺灣疆域，南北相距七百餘里，東西近者二百餘里，遠或三四百里，崇山大溪，鉤連高下。
sourceQuotes.literal: In the ninth month, day gengwu, of the thirteenth year of Guangxu, Governors-General of Fujian and Zhejiang Yang Changjun and Taiwan Governor Liu Mingchuan jointly memorialized, stating in summary: "Taiwan's territory extends more than seven hundred li from north to south; from east to west it is about two hundred li in the nearer parts and three or four hundred li in the farther, with lofty mountains and great rivers interlinked in height and depth.
sourceQuotes.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the ninth month of Guangxu 13, Yang Changjun, governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang, and Liu Mingchuan, governor of Taiwan, submitted a joint memorial in summary as follows: "Taiwan stretches more than seven hundred li from north to south; east to west it is about two hundred li in places and three or four hundred in others, with great mountains and rivers rising and falling in succession.

sourceQuotes.zh: 查彰化橋孜圖地方，山環水複，中開平原，氣象宏敞，又當全臺適中之地，擬照前撫臣岑毓英議，就該處建立省城，分彰化東北之境設首府曰臺灣府，附郭首縣曰臺灣縣，將原有之臺灣府、縣改為臺南府安平縣。
sourceQuotes.literal: Investigating the place Qiaozitu in Zhanghua, mountains surround it and waters encircle it; a plain opens in the center with a grand aspect, and it lies moreover at the central point of all Taiwan; we propose following the former governor Cen Yuying's plan to establish the provincial capital there, divide the northeastern part of Zhanghua to set a capital prefecture called Taiwan Prefecture, with the attached capital county called Taiwan County, and change the original Taiwan Prefecture and county to Tainan Prefecture and Anping County.
sourceQuotes.idiomatic: At Qiaozitu in Zhanghua, ringed by mountains and water, a broad plain opens at the island's geographic center; following former Governor Cen Yuying's proposal, we would place the provincial capital there, carve northeastern Zhanghua into a new Taiwan Prefecture with seat-attached Taiwan County, and rename the old Taiwan Prefecture and county as Tainan Prefecture and Anping County.
